card.fact_statement: Hefazat-e-Islam Bangladesh participated in demonstrations alongside the National Citizen Party.
card.source_span: after a massive demonstration by the National Citizen Party, citizens & other political parties like the Hefazat-e-Islam Bangladesh, the government banned the Awami League

target_qa_variants.question: 国民市民党と共にデモに参加した組織はどれですか？
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: ヘファザト・エ・イスラム・バングラデシュ
target_qa_variants.source_span: after a massive demonstration by the National Citizen Party, citizens & other political parties like the Hefazat-e-Islam Bangladesh, the government banned the Awami League
